description: An eight-state sequencer driven by a Markov chain: every clock draws the next state at random from the probabilities set for the current one, and the output carries that state's value and input

params.text: Steps the chain on by hand, drawing the next state exactly like a clock pulse
Scales the output, 0 to 1, after the state value and the state input have been summed
Smooths the move from one state's knob value to the next, 0 for an instant change and 0.999 for the slowest glide; the signals at the State inputs are not slewed
Sets the value carried by the output while that state is current, -10V to 10V, added to the signal at that state's input
Makes that state the next one, in place of the state drawn at random, until the next clock arrives
Sets the relative probability of the chain moving from one state to another; the eight probabilities for a state are divided by their sum, so equal settings make every destination equally likely
Sets every probability of moving into that state to 0.5, from all eight states at once
Sets every probability of moving into that state to zero, from all eight states at once, so nothing leads there
Sets every probability of leaving that state to 0.5, towards all eight states at once
Sets every probability of leaving that state to zero, towards all eight states at once

inputs.text: A rise to 1V or more moves the chain on: the state drawn last becomes current and the one after it is drawn
The signal carried by the output while that state is current, added to that state's knob value and faded in and out over about 2.5ms to stop a click
A rise to 1V or more makes that state the next one, in place of the state drawn at random

outputs.text: The current state's knob value plus the signal at its input, scaled by the gain and limited to -10V to 10V
Carries the number of the current state, 0V for the first up to 7V for the eighth
A 10V trigger 1ms long when that state becomes the current one

notes: the red lamp beside a state marks the current state and the blue lamp marks the state the next clock will move to
the number of channels at the first State input sets the polyphony of the Out jack
Placed fresh the grid is set to a forward chain, state 1 to 2 to 3 and round to 1 again, so the module runs as a plain eight-step sequencer until a probability is changed
Every state value knob comes up at 0V, so the output rests at 0V until values are set or the state inputs are patched
menu: If all probabilities are zero.... — picks what the chain does when every probability out of the current state is zero: Remain on the current state, or Transitions to all states are equiprobable
